purpose: Read-only tenant metadata audit checklist; no configuration mutation or API credential storage
matchingRules: Match discovered metadata to these exact captions and owner objects; physical system names and metadata IDs are deliberately null because the specification does not assert them.
Preserve the deliberate object caption BOMECS Part API Recod. Do not silently substitute Record.
Resolve every target object inside this component and verify metadata ownership; identical captions in other applications are not equivalent.
Compare declaring references and inverse navigation once per canonical relationship; generated foreign-key scalar metadata is not a separately required business field.
Expected counts describe section 5 business field/grid rows, not raw API property counts. Classify native ID, audit, infrastructure, localized metadata and M:N storage-map metadata separately.

All objects have no proposed business inheritance parent. Inspect actual inheritance chains, report inherited business fields and existing domain-object dependencies, and distinguish unavoidable platform infrastructure.
No extra Location, Category, Owner, publication/version or custom audit fields are required by this specification. No custom Date/Time fields are proposed.
Treat a metadata endpoint which omits inherited fields, inverse navigation or display configuration as incomplete evidence rather than proof of absence.

sharedConstraints.conditionalRequiredness: Requiredness is for persisted normalized records, not every partial-update request. Conditional requirements must not be flattened to unconditional field requiredness.
sharedConstraints.proposedLimits: Text lengths, decimal precision and formats are proposed design values; actual native capacity must be verified.
sharedConstraints.referenceSourceScope: Every internal reference remains in the declaring record Source System except component-local Supplier Relationship Role.
sharedConstraints.inactiveReferences: Inactive source references remain importable for fidelity; new manual selectors exclude inactive values where selectors are authorized.
sharedConstraints.inverseNavigation: Navigation only; no duplicate stored relationship.
sharedConstraints.rawPayload: Full parsed source document/row, including unknown properties; latest accepted receive retained with native history/evidence. Proposed maximum 1 MiB UTF-8 per retained document; verify supported binding and field access.
sharedConstraints.calculations: Importer actions and defaults in prose are not executable Intelex expressions. Do not fabricate calculation expressions to represent them.
sharedConstraints.noExistingBusinessConnections: No lookup, inheritance, matching, synchronization, writeback or relationship to pre-existing Product Management, Supplier Management, PPAP, Drawing, ECS, Location or other application business objects.

metadataAuditChecks: Module ownership and reference target ownership
Declared versus inherited properties and inheritance chain
Default and calculation configuration versus importer behavior
Relationship multiplicity and exact inverse pairing
Uniqueness/key enforcement including nullable tuple behavior
Native raw payload and long-text capacity
Native system and generated foreign-key/map fields classified separately
unresolvedDesignOrRuntimeChecks: Native raw-payload binding/capacity and 65,536-character long-text capacity must be verified; a generic Text type alone does not prove capacity.
Human source-field read-only behavior does not define additional readers or remove administration-group object Rights; importer permissions and persistence path require separate evidence.

Product Family External ID and Raw Payload are conditional. External ID may be null for standalone creation and populated only once; standalone Raw Payload must not be overwritten by nested descriptors.
Scope Part requiredness depends on Revision, and Revision.Part must equal Part. A simple Boolean Required metadata value cannot prove these cross-field rules.
Engineering Change Scope tuple key is provisional and must compare nullable components equally; actual database nullable uniqueness alone may be insufficient.
Only null wire values are currently confirmed for ECN partNumber and partNumberRevLevel; non-null producer DTO shapes and scope ownership remain unresolved.
Family selectedPartNumbersIds External-ID interpretation remains provisional; do not infer native target IDs or Part Number labels.
Native timestamps, retention, receive transaction behavior, namespace agreement and identity behavior cannot be established from static field existence alone.
Part Flag translated Name editability and Supplier Relationship Role.Code immutability after use are state/locale dependent.
Proposed local seed values are not an API-supplied Role default; no automatic Manufacturing assignment is authorized.

canonicalSection5Lines: ## 5 Canonical field implementation contract

`Y` means required in the persisted normalized record; `N` means optional; `Conditional` means the row identifies when a value is required. This does not mean every property is required in a partial-update body. `None` means no default exists; `NULL` means intentionally initialized without a value. Text lengths and decimal precision are proposed. Do not truncate, normalize identifier spelling, strip source spaces, or silently round costs.

**Importer** means the dedicated authorized receive service executing operations PMAPI-PART, PMAPI-FAMILY, and PMAPI-ECN from section 6. It populates source fields through configured native persistence APIs; no executable Intelex expressions or fictitious endpoint names are specified. Human access is for Administrators and Part Integration - Admin Security Group. These groups maintain the expressly editable local catalogue fields and supplier Role. Importer-owned source controls, immutable keys, and inverse lists retain their data behavior; they do not define additional access audiences or reduce the groups' object Rights.

All internal references must remain in the declaring record's Source System, except Supplier Relationship Role, which is a component-local governed catalogue without a source namespace. Source-owned relationships have no direct human selector; their links are maintained by the receive operation as data behavior. Inactive source references may be imported to preserve the received facts. Active?=FALSE prevents new manual assignments within this component where a selector is authorized; existing references remain valid. There is no downstream application behavior.

**Raw JSON storage:** retain the complete parsed JSON document or row in native Unicode long-text/document storage, with a proposed maximum of 1 MiB UTF-8 per retained document. Native capacity and the exact binding must be verified before build completion. Do not claim that a native JSON scalar type exists. If a supported text field cannot retain the complete allowed content, select native document storage for the same logical field and verify field-level access. The full ECN response envelope is native integration evidence; it is not another business object. Reject overflow before mutation and retain failure evidence through the receive service.

No custom Date/Time fields are proposed. Native audit and execution timestamps must preserve server instants and display through supported user time zones. No publication copies or version fields apply; the stored records are source-aligned mutable data with native audit history. Human field access, including Raw Payload, is for Administrators and Part Integration - Admin Security Group. Source-owned controls remain read only on receiving screens as data behavior; do not require a separate technical-reader membership or exclude either administration group from source evidence. Conditional requiredness does not hide a field unless its row explicitly says so.

The Part sample resolves a family with External ID `0cd34a52-452e-4a2a-81fd-b0130113de3b`, Name `94203SL00A`, and Active? true. The standalone sample instead supplies Name `85132SL550`, Notes null, and no selected parts. It does not establish the same family identity.

Selected IDs provisionally refer to BOMECS Part API Recod.External ID in the same Source System, not Part Number labels or generated target IDs. A non-empty example is needed to confirm this mapping. Resolve every selected ID before mutation. Reject missing or cross-source parts and assignments to parts currently linked to another family; no part records are created from an ID list. A present empty array on an identified update clears only that family's memberships, leaving the part records intact.

Standalone creates require transport/integration idempotency context for safe retries. Standalone updates require a native family ID or an already resolved source ID in request context; the body alone cannot identify an existing family. The same Name does not authorize an automatic merge. Native uniqueness and retention must support optional external IDs and creation-request mapping before implementation.
